title: Identifier
description: A coded value assigned to an entity within an identification scheme. Identifiers disambiguate entities such as persons, groups, locations, administrative areas, or records within a specific registry or catalog. The identifier is the value and its scheme; documents that carry identifiers (passports, national ID cards, beneficiary cards) are modeled separately as IdentityDocument.

identifier_value.description: The alphanumeric value of the identifier as issued or recorded.

identifier_scheme_id.description: A URI or code that identifies the scheme or system under which the identifier was assigned.

identifier_scheme_name.description: The human-readable name of the identifier scheme, such as 'National Identity Number' or 'Social Security Number'.

identifier_type.description: The category of identifier value (for example, national ID number, passport number, P-code).
